newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe rebounds sharply after slide.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe rebounds sharply after slide.

text.p: Polish construction firm Espebepe SA surged 9.5 percent to 3.45 zlotys after having fallen 45.2 percent since it said a week ago Tuesday that it could go bankrupt, traders said.
"It's seems some players are speculating and trying to take a profit after two or three sessions -- it's a very risky game that sometimes pays off," one trader said.
Espebepe's turnover was at 0.4 million zlotys on Thursday.
The company said last week it could go bankrupt if its creditors did not agree to a debt-write-off deal.
